# algolia_agent_provider (Data Source)

Use this data source to read an Algolia Agent Studio language model provider without exposing secret credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algolia_agent_provider" "openai" {
  name          = "OpenAI Production"
  provider_name = "openai"

  openai {
    api_key  = var.openai_api_key
    base_url = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
  }
}

data "algolia_agent_provider" "openai" {
  provider_id = algolia_agent_provider.openai.id
}

output "provider_name" {
  value = data.algolia_agent_provider.openai.name
}

output "provider_base_url" {
  value = data.algolia_agent_provider.openai.openai.base_url
}

variable "openai_api_key" {
  description = "OpenAI API key used to create the Agent Studio provider."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the Agent Studio provider.

### Optional

- `google_genai` (Block, Optional) Google Gemini provider credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--google_genai))

### Read-Only

- `anthropic` (Block, Read-only) Anthropic provider credentials and optional endpoint configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--anthropic))
- `azure_openai` (Block, Read-only) Azure OpenAI provider configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--azure_openai))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp of when the provider was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the provider.
- `last_used_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp of the last provider usage, if available.
- `name` (String) Display name for the Agent Studio provider.
- `openai` (Block, Read-only) OpenAI provider credentials and endpoint configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--openai))
- `openai_compatible` (Block, Read-only) Generic OpenAI-compatible provider credentials and endpoint configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--openai_compatible))
- `provider_name` (String) Provider type.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp of when the provider was last updated.
